SUBJECT: Mrs. Evelyn Uleaga, History.

Mrs. Evelyn Uleaga was born of British
parents now believed to reside in British Columbia.
She was married to a Mr. G.J. Burkhardt, Swiss,
who committed suicide on November 28, 1933, by shooting
himself with a pistol, in his apartment in the Glen
Line Building, 2 Peking Road, at the age of 54 years.
The late G.J. Burkhardt was a partner in the
now defunct firm of Burkhardt, Buchan & Co., which
firm was the successor to L.R. Burkhardt & Co.,
changing its name in 1920 when R.S. Buchan joined it.
In 1926 the firm was known to be closely connected
with the local branch of the Soviet concern
"EXPORTHLEB", and was also known to have been
financed by funds from Moscow; in order to enable
business to be conducted through the medium of a
British firm when it was not convenient for a Soviet
concern to act directly.
Subsequent to the death of Burkhardt, the firm
was reorganized under the title of Burkhardt, Buchan
& Co. (1934) Ltd. and continued business under this
name until the summer of 1936, when it went into
liquidation, the directors owing money widely in
Shanghai.
Evelyn Uleaga is the sister of R.S. (Reginald
Stuart) Buchan and William Muir Buchan, the latter
having been employed in the Shanghai Fire Brigade
from 1927 to 1932, and in 1934 joining the firm of
Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. as a partner. Both brothers,

主题：伊夫林·乌莱加夫人（Mrs. Evelyn Uleaga），履历。

伊夫林·乌莱加夫人出生于英国父母家庭，其父母据信现居不列颠哥伦比亚省。她曾嫁给瑞士人 G.J. 布克哈特先生（Mr. G.J. Burkhardt），后者于1933年11月28日在北京路2号格兰轮船公司大楼（Glen Line Building）的公寓内用手枪自杀身亡，享年54岁。已故的 G.J. 布克哈特是现已解散的布克哈特、布坎公司（Burkhardt, Buchan & Co.）的合伙人，该公司是 L.R. 布克哈特公司（L.R. Burkhardt & Co.）的继任者，于1920年 R.S. 布坎加入时更改了名称。据悉，1926年该公司与苏联企业“出口粮食公司”（EXPORTHLEB）的上海分行关系密切，并已知其资金来源于莫斯科；这是为了在苏联企业不便直接行动时，能够通过一家英国公司作为中介开展业务。
布克哈特死后，该公司重组为布克哈特、布坎有限公司（1934）（Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. (1934) Ltd.），并以此名称继续经营，直至1936年夏进入清算程序，当时董事们在上海欠下广泛债务。
伊夫林·乌莱加是 R.S.（雷金纳德·斯图尔特）布坎和威廉·缪尔·布坎的姐妹，后者曾在1927年至1932年间受雇于上海救火会，并于1934年作为合伙人加入布克哈特、布坎公司。兄弟二人，

together with a sister, Doreen, who was also a
director of the Company and their mother, Mrs. H.Buchan
resided at 27 The Bund, during 1933 - 1935, occupying
three rooms in that part of the building, housing
the offices of Mr. B.A. MacDonald, Canadian Government
Trade Commissioner for China. The rooms occupied by
the Buchan family, constituted the only private
apartment in a building used exclusively by business
offices of various firms. It is reported that the
contiguity of the Trade Commissioner's offices was taken
advantage of by friends of the family, including Soviet
employees and agents, who used the place as a rendezvous.
Reginald Stuart Buchan was married to the
daughter of a former Cuban Minister in Shanghai but
later he and his wife separated.
Following the death of Burkhardt, his wife
went to Manila where she married a Spaniard of the
name of Francisco (Paco) Oleaga. This man was, for
some years, a trusted employee of the Manila branch of
Elizalde & Co. Inc., but just prior to, or shortly
subsequent to, his marriage to Evelyn Burkhardt, left
the firm, and it later came to light that bonds to the
value of 40,000 pesos could not be accounted for.
It is not known whether the company took any action
against Oleaga in this connection. It is believed
that Oleaga now follows no regular profession.
In July 1940 Mrs. Evelyn Burkhardt was cohabit-
ing with Hilaire du Berrier, U.S.A. citizen of French
descent. Du Berrier is a very questionable character

主题：(2)
连同他们的姐妹多琳（Doreen，也是公司董事）以及母亲 H. 布坎夫人，在1933年至1935年间居住于外滩27号，占据该建筑中容纳加拿大政府驻华贸易专员 B.A. 麦克唐纳先生（Mr. B.A. MacDonald）办公室的部分中的三个房间。布坎家族所占用的房间构成了这栋完全由各类商行办公场所使用的建筑中唯一的私人公寓。据报，贸易专员办公室的邻近位置被布坎家族的朋友，包括苏联雇员和代理人所利用，将该处作为聚会地点。
雷金纳德·斯图尔特·布坎娶了一位前古巴驻上海公使的女儿为妻，但后来他与妻子分居。
布克哈特死后，他的妻子前往马尼拉，在那里嫁给了一位名叫弗朗西斯科（帕科）·奥莱加（Francisco (Paco) Oleaga）的西班牙人。此人多年来一直是伊利萨尔德股份有限公司（Elizalde & Co. Inc.）马尼拉分行的可信雇员，但在与伊夫林·布克哈特结婚前后不久离开了该公司，随后发现价值40,000比索的债券下落不明。不知公司是否就此对奥莱加采取了任何行动。据信奥莱加目前无固定职业。
1940年7月，伊夫林·布克哈特夫人与具有法国血统的美国公民希莱尔·杜贝里埃（Hilaire du Berrier）同居。杜贝里埃是一个品行极为可疑的人

SUBJECT: (3)

and was an aviator on the side of the Nationalist forces
during the Spanish Civil War and also took part in the
Italo-Abyssinian conflict as a bomber and reconnaissance
pilot. He also endeavoured to obtain similar employment
with the Chinese Central Government forces but whether
or not he was successful is somewhat doubtful.

In July 1940 du Perrier called on Mr. Hugh
Middleton and offered his services to the British
Forces but was not accepted. He has also worked as
an agent for the Japanese Intelligence Service.

To date of this report very little information
has been gathered regarding the daughter of Mrs. Uleaga.

She was, until recently, known locally as
Viki Burkhardt and is known to be an associate of
"Princess" Rajkumari Sumair Apjit Singh (Patiala).

About two months ago she returned from Hongkong
and has since styled herself Countess Victoria Lea.
Nothing definite regarding her right to such title is
known, but it is generally considered that the title is
fictitious.

Mrs. Uleaga is presently reported to be closely
associating herself with an Italian "Commander".

主题：(3)

曾在西班牙内战期间作为飞行员效力于国民军一方，并以轰炸机和侦察机飞行员身份参与了意阿冲突。他还试图在中国中央政府军队中获得类似职务，但是否成功则颇值得怀疑。

1940年7月，杜佩里埃（du Perrier，原文如此，应指杜贝里埃）拜访了休·米德尔顿先生（Mr. Hugh Middleton），并向英军提供服务，但未被接受。他还曾作为日本情报机构的代理人工作。

截至本报告撰写之日，关于乌莱加夫人的女儿收集到的信息极少。

她直到最近在当地还被称为维基·布克哈特（Viki Burkhardt），已知她是“公主”拉杰库马里·苏迈尔·阿普吉特·辛格（Rajkumari Sumair Apjit Singh，帕蒂亚拉）的交往伙伴。

大约两个月前她从香港返回，此后自称维多利亚·利亚女伯爵（Countess Victoria Lea）。对于她拥有此头衔的权利并无确切了解，但普遍认为该头衔是虚构的。

据报，乌莱加夫人目前正与一位意大利“指挥官”密切交往。

助理处长（特别处）

R. A. Young
副督察长
